newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan bourse continues upward trend.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan bourse continues upward trend.

text.p: The Casablanca bourse closed higher on Thursday due largely to blue chip companies that gained ground as brokers expect good results this year, a market analyst said.
The all-share index rose 0.56 percent to close at 411.42 points. Banque Commerciale du Maroc gained 20 dirhams to close at 680 dirhams.

"BCM continues its rise as market analysts expect 16 percent increase in 1996 earning per share. However, the share price has already gained 39 percent since the beginning of the year," said Anas Alami, analyst at Upline Securities.
The rise was also due to the scarcity of the stock.

Banque Marocaine du Commerce Exterieur, one of the most liquid stocks, rose three dirhams to close at 400 dirhams. ONA Group stock, Morocco's largest private conglomerate, was not traded and remained at 410 dirhams.

It recently purchased four mines, including a silver mine at the equivalent of $75 million. But stockbrokers expect the stock value to rise in the coming weeks. SONASID, the country's giant steel plant operator that was recently privatised, gained one dirham to close at 340 dirhams. The bourse total trading jumped to 69.2 million dirhams from 5.9 million dirhams on the previous session. ($1= 8.6 dirhams)
